name: What Mother Left Behind
description: Milena believes her mother left something in room 21 before being moved from the district. Help her recover a trace of her family.
offerText: Could you check the safe in your room?

stages.description: Find the letter in the room 21 safe.

_codex.narrativeIntent: Milena discovers her mother previously lived in the player’s room; the personal clue begins a separate family investigation.
implementationNotes: Preserve room 21 and original letter item.
Letter suggests mother was moved without clear notice, not that she knew the whole conspiracy.
_codex.compatibility: _codex is design metadata, not an executable trigger. Keep all original IDs, trigger shapes, rewards, and existing save compatibility. Add runtime support only after implementing the documented systems.
